title: 2.3 Characteristics of a Computer System
description: Speed, accuracy, storage, versatility and other characteristics

questions.question: How fast can computers execute instructions depending on processor clock speed?
options: B. Millions or billions of instructions per second
D. Only a few per second
questions.correctAnswer: B. Millions or billions of instructions per second

questions.question: On what does the accuracy of a computer depend?
options: C. Correctness of input and programming of instructions
A. The size of the screen
B. The color of the case
questions.correctAnswer: C. Correctness of input and programming of instructions

questions.question: Computers operate on which type of logic to ensure accuracy?
questions.correctAnswer: C. Precise binary logic

questions.question: What is the function of RAM in a computer system?
options: A. Permanent storage for all files
B. Temporary storage for data and instructions currently being processed
questions.correctAnswer: B. Temporary storage for data and instructions currently being processed

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of secondary storage?
questions.correctAnswer: C. Solid-state drive

questions.question: What characteristic allows computers to be used for different tasks by changing software?
questions.correctAnswer: A. Versatility

questions.question: What types of data can computers process?
options: D. Text, images, audio, video and other data
questions.correctAnswer: D. Text, images, audio, video and other data

questions.question: What is automation in the context of computers?
options: B. Repetitive tasks performed by programming
questions.correctAnswer: B. Repetitive tasks performed by programming

questions.question: What is a benefit of computer automation?
questions.correctAnswer: B. Increased efficiency and accuracy

questions.question: What does computer security primarily protect against?
options: B. Unauthorized access, breaches, and malicious activities
questions.correctAnswer: B. Unauthorized access, breaches, and malicious activities

questions.question: Which of the following is a security mechanism used in computers?
questions.correctAnswer: A. Encryption

questions.question: What is meant by reliability of a computer system?
options: A. Consistent and accurate performance of intended functions
questions.correctAnswer: A. Consistent and accurate performance of intended functions

questions.question: What does scalability refer to in a computer system?
options: A. Ability to accommodate workload changes without significant performance degradation
questions.correctAnswer: A. Ability to accommodate workload changes without significant performance degradation

questions.question: What does compatibility mean for computers?
options: A. Working efficiently with different hardware, software, or data formats
questions.correctAnswer: A. Working efficiently with different hardware, software, or data formats

questions.question: What does upgradeability allow a computer system to do?
options: A. Enhance or expand capabilities by adding/replacing hardware or upgrading software
questions.correctAnswer: A. Enhance or expand capabilities by adding/replacing hardware or upgrading software

questions.question: Which of the following best describes storage capacity of computers?
options: B. Can store massive amounts of data
questions.correctAnswer: B. Can store massive amounts of data

questions.question: True or False: A computer will always produce accurate results regardless of incorrect input.
questions.correctAnswer: False

questions.question: True or False: Automation allows humans to focus on more complex and creative tasks.
questions.correctAnswer: True

questions.question: True or False: RAM provides permanent storage for data.
questions.correctAnswer: False

questions.question: True or False: Security measures include authentication, firewalls, and antivirus software.
questions.correctAnswer: True
